Physical/conceptual network diagram (Figure 3.4.1, "MEF IP Service Model MEF 69.1 MEF 61.1"), a slide titled "IP Service Diagram" subtitled "Connecting subscriber locations using a MEF 3.0 IP service."

A large light-blue cloud icon labelled **"IPVC"** (IP Virtual Connection) sits in the centre, with three purple building icons around it representing subscriber locations, each connected to the cloud by a black line meeting at a diamond-shaped node:

- **A** (top right) — connection point into the cloud.
- **B** (right) — connection point into the cloud.
- **C** (bottom right) — connection point into the cloud, with the leftmost connection point (bottom left of the cloud) labelled **"IPVC End Point"**.

The three subscriber sites are all interconnected purely via the shared IPVC cloud (a multipoint/any-to-any IP virtual connection), illustrating the MEF IP Service used as the underlay for the SD-WAN overlay service described elsewhere in this document.
